name: Three signal categories: flight-triggered, insider cluster buying, both
rationale: Replaces the single insider-silence threshold with explainable categories. The insider cluster rule is the project blueprint's buying-cluster definition (three distinct buyers within 14 days), extended to any reporting-owner type with joint filers counted once; it was fixed before any case was evaluated. The flight rule needs reviewed company-aircraft links and completed visits, which do not exist yet.

flight.description: A reviewed company aircraft completes a ground stop of at least one hour within 50 km of another tracked company's offices.
flight.requires: Human-reviewed company-aircraft links, office locations and completed-visit coverage (C10-C14)
